Page 255 Cont.
Jan. 14 Wm. Chrysler - 96 - prayed for last Wed .... having requested to be taken to a Cath. Hosp .... Asked for baptism. Received everything died a happy Death.
Page 256
Jan. 14 Hortors -- throat cancer ..... Mrs. Enray - 37 - voice gone Gert Cummings - 46 - Expecting
Jan. 15 Frances Gittings - 28 - 20 yrs sleeping sickness since 9 - Very intell- igent. Helps mother
Leo C. McDougall - 40 - intestinal
Mary L. McDoyal Rev. Stanley Doll. . . . . Jerome Boeve - 3 - eye trouble
Ethel Amo - 35 - Northville T.B. San. has two small children. ...
22 Eugene Redmann - heart ..
22 Eugene Trylinski - 3 - acute lukemia - home from Ann Arbor Hospital To-day as hopeless - nothing can be done. Enrolled at 3 P.M. Anton - Noseda - 22 - in Europe - Mother.
Page 257 . Jan. 23 Eugene Trylinski - 3 - lukemia in Providence Hosp. In critical condi- tion. Enrolled yesterday a perpetual member in Ser. Mass Assoc'n. Parents seldom at Holy Com. promise to go more frequently - Confession and Holy Com. tomorrow.
Jackie Parport - 2 - got "trench - mouth" early last month - in fact since Thanksgiving Day. Father went to California in poor health. En- rolled a week To-day perpetually.
E'd J. Jacques - 48 - bladder and kidney infection.
